title: Chicken Broccoli and Mushroom Stir Fry
instructions: Trim the chicken breast of any excess fat and pat dry with paper towels. In a medium bowl, toss the chicken with ¼ cup flour until evenly coated. Remove the chicken to a plate, leaving the remaining flour in the bowl — you'll use it for the sauce.
To make the sauce: to the bowl with the remaining flour, add 2 cups of the chicken stock, the honey, soy sauce, grated ginger, grated garlic, and sesame oil; stir until smooth. Set aside.

Heat a wok or large heavy-bottomed skillet over medium-high and add 1 tbsp olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken pieces and spread out evenly. Let the chicken sit for a minute before stirring, then stir-fry for 5 minutes, until browned. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.

Add another 1 tbsp of oil to the same pan. Once hot, add the broccoli florets, onion, and sliced mushrooms and stir-fry for 4 minutes, until the mushrooms are softened and the broccoli is crisp-tender.

Stir the sauce again, then pour it over the hot vegetables. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Simmer for 2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened, then toss in the chicken and cook for another 30 seconds, until heated through. Season to taste with salt if needed and serve over hot rice.
notes: Doc updated quantities: chicken 1 lb → 2 lb, sauce stock 1 cup → 2 cups, total stock 1 cup → 3 cups, soy sauce ¼ cup → ½ cup, garlic 2 → 3 cloves, sesame oil 2 → 3 tsp.
